info.name: Bhoomi Suvidha — Nivesh Mitra 3.0 Integration
info.description: APIs: get a token, submit an application for AI analysis, re-fetch a result, and report payment status (with ServiceNo). Set `username`/`password` in the collection variables (or right in the first request's body) before running.

exec: console.log('Saved token to {{token}} for the next requests.');

request.description: Returns { token, token_type, expires_in }. The token is auto-saved to {{token}} by the test script above, so you can run requests 2 and 3 right after without copy-pasting.
Returns the full discrepancy report immediately (checks, thirdPartyVerification, applicantHistory) plus analysisId, auto-saved to {{analysisId}} for request 3.
Returns the identical response from request 2, for the given analysisId. 404 if it doesn't exist.

Nivesh Mitra payment-complete signal. Body: applicationId, status (boolean), optional ServiceNo. Returns { applicationId, status, paymentConfirmedAt, ServiceNo }. Only status=true is persisted as paid.
Returns stored payment status for the most recent submission of this applicationId: { applicationId, status, paymentConfirmedAt, ServiceNo }.
